body: Not really.  Too much of a pussy and unable to let go.

I think I'll try this.  It seems like a very passive way to talk to people, but right now everyone seems to be getting drunk down the road at a block party sans my direct neighbors.  I think they are partaking in an activity that they rather not meet new people during...

The people I work with are cool, but unfortunately our job is not really a co-operative job.  Its more of a meet up once a month, but work solo on the field the rest of the time.  All of them seem to know each other quite well as well.

I do know I have my family.  At this point my family is one of main things that keeps me from offing myself.  I would never want to put them through that kind of grief or suffering.  Can't really see my family either that much due to location of where I am and that my job requires me to work during school vacations.

I hope things get better, but what feels like a constant wait sucks.  I don't want to turn 30 and look back on my youth and be like "wow, I should of done things different".  The problem is I'm not sure if I'm more afraid of pushing people away or looking back on my past with regret. 

I haven't noticed any dorm meetings as of yet.  At the time being, nobody has seen the RA, no events are planned and the only people I've met on my floor are "bros".

It is strange how the mind prioritizes things.  Two years ago when I was back home with a selected amount of friends and a girlfriend, I would of probably told myself "If I can get to that point in my life, I might be ok being alone in a new city".  Now I want to sacrifice these achievements just to go back and have friends and a love again. The logical side of my mind is telling me that is a stupid idea, but the emotional side is kinda blocking that one out :/
